lines.zh: 斥候沿着觅食路线走，脚步无声
lines.en: The sentinel walks the foraging route without a sound.

lines.zh: 它把身体压得很低，腹尾却翘着
lines.en: It keeps low, yet its tail abdomen stays raised.

lines.zh: 前肢收在胸前，像两把折起的刀
lines.en: Its forelimbs fold at its chest like two shut blades.

lines.zh: 它每走十步就停一次，听土里的动静
lines.en: Every ten steps it halts, listening through the soil.

lines.zh: 六足落点极准，专踩硬土
lines.en: Its six feet land precisely, choosing only hard ground.

lines.zh: 它绕着巢的外缘走，不走近路
lines.en: It circles the nest's rim rather than take the short way.

lines.zh: 长尾拖在身后，尖端微微上翘
lines.en: Its long tail drags behind, tip slightly raised.

lines.zh: 它走过菌毯，菌丝都没断
lines.en: It crosses the fungus carpet without breaking a thread.

lines.zh: 影子比身体窄，因为它贴着墙走
lines.en: Its shadow is narrower than its body as it hugs the wall.

lines.zh: 斥候的步子慢，但没有一步多余
lines.en: The sentinel's pace is slow, and never wasteful.

lines.zh: 它先侧身过窄缝，尾才跟上
lines.en: It slips sideways through the gap, tail trailing after.

lines.zh: 前肢垂着走，方便随时抬起
lines.en: It walks with forelimbs low, ready to rise.

lines.zh: 它沿着老路，路线一天没变
lines.en: It follows the old route, unchanged for a day.

lines.zh: 它踩过的地方，苔被压平又弹回
lines.en: Where it steps, moss flattens and springs back.

lines.zh: 它把前肢抬了抬，又放下去
lines.en: It lifts its forelimbs, then lowers them.

lines.zh: 它侧着身，从两根根须间过
lines.en: It passes sideways between two roots.

lines.zh: 它站在暗处，一动不动像根枯枝
lines.en: It stands in the dark, motionless as a dead branch.

lines.zh: 斥候能等一整天，只为一次伏击
lines.en: A sentinel can wait all day for one ambush.

lines.zh: 腹尾悬在半空，缓慢地左右摆
lines.en: Its tail hangs in the air, swaying slowly side to side.

lines.zh: 它把前肢擦干净，一遍又一遍
lines.en: It wipes its forelimbs clean, over and over.

lines.zh: 暗处只有它两只眼睛反光
lines.en: In the dark, only its two eyes catch the light.

lines.zh: 它把呼吸压到几乎听不见
lines.en: It presses its breathing down to near silence.

lines.zh: 它伏在觅食道旁，等队伍经过
lines.en: It lies beside the foraging trail, waiting for the column.

lines.zh: 它一动不动，连触角都僵着
lines.en: It does not move, not even its antennae.

lines.zh: 长尾尖端轻轻点着土面
lines.en: The tip of its long tail taps the soil softly.

lines.zh: 它的身体和洞壁是同一种灰
lines.en: Its body is the same gray as the tunnel wall.

lines.zh: 它在数经过的工蚁，一只一只
lines.en: It counts the passing workers, one by one.

lines.zh: 等太久，它把前肢换了个姿势
lines.en: Waiting too long, it shifts its forelimbs once.

lines.zh: 它转头，动作慢得像生锈
lines.en: It turns its head slowly, as if rusted.

lines.zh: 它的头能转过来看你，身体不动
lines.en: Its head turns to watch you while its body stays still.

lines.zh: 两只眼盯着你，前肢抬了半寸
lines.en: Two eyes fix on you; its forelimbs lift half an inch.

lines.zh: 它把你当成路过的猎物
lines.en: It takes you for passing prey.

lines.zh: 它垂下头，从下往上看你
lines.en: It lowers its head and looks up at you from below.

lines.zh: 它的目光落在你的脚踝上
lines.en: Its gaze settles on your ankle.

lines.zh: 你走动时，它的头跟着转
lines.en: As you move, its head tracks you.

lines.zh: 它没动，可你知道它已经决定了
lines.en: It has not moved, yet you know it has decided.

lines.zh: 尾尖对着你，慢慢画了个圈
lines.en: Its tail tip aims at you and draws a slow circle.

lines.zh: 它闻了闻空气，把你归了类
lines.en: It tastes the air and files you away.

lines.zh: 它的壳裂开，露出底下的膜
lines.en: Its shell splits, showing the membrane beneath.

lines.zh: 它发出一声短促的嘶叫
lines.en: It gives one short hiss.

lines.zh: 受伤的斥候不逃，只退半步
lines.en: A wounded sentinel does not flee; it gives half a step.

lines.zh: 它把断掉的前肢收在胸前
lines.en: It tucks the broken forelimb against its chest.

lines.zh: 它的尾垂下，尖端还在颤
lines.en: Its tail sags, tip still trembling.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了它的伏击姿势
lines.en: The blow breaks its ambush stance.

lines.zh: 痛让它放弃了藏身，站了起来
lines.en: Pain makes it abandon cover and stand tall.

lines.zh: 它用另一只前肢撑地，稳住
lines.en: It braces on its other forelimb and holds.

lines.zh: 伤口在节间，流得很慢
lines.en: The wound is between segments and bleeds slowly.

lines.zh: 它没退，反而把尾抬高了
lines.en: It does not retreat; it raises its tail higher.

lines.zh: 你放下的肉，它看都不看
lines.en: It ignores the meat you set down.

lines.zh: 斥候只吃会动的东西
lines.en: A sentinel eats only what moves.

lines.zh: 它用前肢碰了碰诱饵，退开
lines.en: It touches the bait with a forelimb and withdraws.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道让它偏了偏头
lines.en: The smell of carrion tilts its head.

lines.zh: 它宁可等一只活的工蚁
lines.en: It would rather wait for a living worker.

lines.zh: 你的手一晃，它的前肢就抬起来
lines.en: Your hand twitches, and its forelimbs rise.

lines.zh: 食物落在地上，它绕了半圈
lines.en: The food lands; it circles halfway around it.

lines.zh: 它闻出诱饵上有铁的味道
lines.en: It smells iron on the bait.

lines.zh: 饿了三天，它才肯碰死物
lines.en: Only after three days hungry will it touch dead meat.

lines.zh: 它把诱饵拨到远处，再守着
lines.en: It flicks the bait aside and then guards it.

lines.zh: 它撞上你，前肢立刻扣紧
lines.en: It bumps you, and its forelimbs clamp at once.

lines.zh: 它的壳很薄，撞起来却硬
lines.en: Its shell looks thin, yet it hits hard.

lines.zh: 你碰到它的尾，整条弹直了
lines.en: You touch its tail, and the whole length snaps straight.

lines.zh: 它被撞退，尾尖仍对着你
lines.en: Knocked back, its tail tip still aims at you.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，它顺势贴上了墙
lines.en: After the bump, it lets itself onto the wall.

lines.zh: 它的前肢钩住你的衣角
lines.en: Its forelimbs hook into your hem.

lines.zh: 它一撞就滑开，像涂了油
lines.en: It slides off at a touch, as if oiled.

lines.zh: 你踩到它的尾节，它嘶了一声
lines.en: You step on its tail segment, and it hisses.

lines.zh: 它撞在你腿上，随即翻身落地
lines.en: It strikes your leg and rolls to the ground.

lines.zh: 它从你腋下钻过，尾擦着你的腰
lines.en: It slips under your arm, tail grazing your waist.

lines.zh: 繁殖轮不到它，它只管守着路口
lines.en: Breeding is not its lot; it only holds the crossing.

lines.zh: 皇族起飞时，它在洞口站岗
lines.en: When royals take flight, it stands guard at the mouth.

lines.zh: 它闻到皇族的气味，让开了路
lines.en: It smells a royal and steps aside.

lines.zh: 这一季的婚飞，它一只只数过去
lines.en: It counts the season's mating flights one by one.

lines.zh: 它的身体里没有卵，只有力气
lines.en: There are no eggs in its body, only strength.

lines.zh: 有雄蚁靠近，它先验一验气味
lines.en: When a male nears, it checks the scent first.

lines.zh: 交配的季节过去，它还站在原地
lines.en: The season passes, and it still stands there.

lines.zh: 它替女皇守着产房的门
lines.en: It keeps the nursery door for the queen.

lines.zh: 它把闯入的雄蚁赶出去
lines.en: It drives intruding males back out.

lines.zh: 它不懂那件事，只懂守住这条道
lines.en: It does not understand mating, only holding this path.

lines.zh: 它捡起一枚翅，闻了闻
lines.en: It picks up a wing and sniffs it.

lines.zh: 地上的虫壳，它一片片翻过来
lines.en: It turns over each husk on the ground.

lines.zh: 它叼着东西，前肢仍空着
lines.en: It holds something in its jaws, forelimbs still free.

lines.zh: 太重的东西，它用尾勾着拖
lines.en: Too heavy to lift, it hooks it with its tail and drags.

lines.zh: 它把石子摆成一排，不知为何
lines.en: It lines pebbles up in a row, for no clear reason.

lines.zh: 它只捡和巢有关的物件
lines.en: It collects only things that belong to the nest.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物，它拨到路边
lines.en: It sweeps your dropped item off the path.

lines.zh: 它捡起骨头，掂了掂就扔了
lines.en: It picks up a bone, weighs it, and tosses it aside.

lines.zh: 它把树脂捏成小球带走
lines.en: It rolls resin into a small ball and carries it off.

lines.zh: 它用前肢夹着，颚里还叼一个
lines.en: It carries one in its forelimbs and another in its jaws.

lines.zh: 它的头转过来，停在你身上
lines.en: Its head swings over and stops on you.

lines.zh: 你踩断了一根枯枝，它听见了
lines.en: You snap a dry twig; it heard.

lines.zh: 它伏低身体，前肢慢慢张开
lines.en: It drops low, forelimbs opening slowly.

lines.zh: 它判定你是猎物，不是路过的
lines.en: It decides you are prey, not a passerby.

lines.zh: 腹尾抬到最高，尖端朝前
lines.en: Its tail rises to full height, tip forward.

lines.zh: 它把重心移到后足上
lines.en: It shifts its weight onto its hind legs.

lines.zh: 你在它的伏击圈里，已经站了一会儿
lines.en: You have stood in its ambush circle for a while.

lines.zh: 它的前肢内侧有一排细齿
lines.en: A row of fine teeth lines the inside of its forelimbs.

lines.zh: 它没有立刻扑，先绕到侧面
lines.en: It does not lunge yet; it circles to your flank.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸停了半拍，然后加快
lines.en: Its breathing pauses, then quickens.

lines.zh: 它把出口让开，只堵住你背后
lines.en: It leaves the exit open and seals only your back.

lines.zh: 这条路它守了很久，今天终于等到
lines.en: It has guarded this path long, and today it finally has you.

lines.zh: 它一步一步挪，脚步轻得像雨
lines.en: It creeps step by step, light as rain.

lines.zh: 尾尖一直指着你，从不偏离
lines.en: Its tail tip points at you and never wavers.

lines.zh: 它绕到你的影子里
lines.en: It moves into your shadow.

lines.zh: 你转身，它已经换了个位置
lines.en: You turn, and it has already shifted position.

lines.zh: 它把前肢举高，像随时要合拢
lines.en: It raises its forelimbs, ready to snap shut.

lines.zh: 它不出声，连呼吸都藏起来
lines.en: It makes no sound, hiding even its breathing.

lines.zh: 它在等你的脚落下那一刻
lines.en: It waits for the moment your foot lands.

lines.zh: 每绕一圈，包围圈就小一尺
lines.en: Each pass tightens the circle by a foot.

lines.zh: 它贴着洞顶爬，从上面看你
lines.en: It crawls along the ceiling, watching you from above.

lines.zh: 它的耐心比你的腿更持久
lines.en: Its patience outlasts your legs.

lines.zh: 它算准了你退向哪块石头
lines.en: It knows which stone you will retreat to.

lines.zh: 你听到的沙沙声，是它在换足
lines.en: That rustle is it changing feet.

lines.zh: 前肢合拢，快得看不清
lines.en: Its forelimbs snap shut faster than sight.

lines.zh: 尾钩扎进你的肩，立刻缩回
lines.en: The tail barb sinks into your shoulder and withdraws.

lines.zh: 它一剪，你的护腕裂了
lines.en: One snip, and your bracer splits.

lines.zh: 它用前肢把你往怀里带
lines.en: Its forelimbs pull you toward its chest.

lines.zh: 尾巴从上方劈下，你来不及躲
lines.en: The tail comes down from above; you are too slow.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的手腕，同时收拢前肢
lines.en: It bites your wrist and folds its forelimbs in.

lines.zh: 一击之后，它退开两尺再进
lines.en: After one strike it backs two feet and comes again.

lines.zh: 它的钩尖有倒刺，抽出来带着布
lines.en: Its barb is serrated; it comes out with cloth.

lines.zh: 你挡住了前肢，却没挡住尾
lines.en: You stop the forelimbs but not the tail.

lines.zh: 它把整个身体压在你身上
lines.en: It throws its whole body against you.

lines.zh: 它从蛹壳里挣出，前肢先伸出来
lines.en: It struggles from the pupal shell, forelimbs first.

lines.zh: 刚孵化的斥候，尾还是弯的
lines.en: A newly hatched sentinel, its tail still curled.

lines.zh: 它在洞口站了很久，才敢往里走
lines.en: It stands at the mouth a long time before going in.

lines.zh: 工蚁把它推到觅食道旁
lines.en: Workers push it to the edge of the foraging trail.

lines.zh: 它学着伏低身体，第一次不够像
lines.en: It practices lying low; the first try is not convincing.

lines.zh: 它的颜色天生就和洞壁一样
lines.en: Its color matches the tunnel wall from birth.

lines.zh: 第一只经过的工蚁，它没有动
lines.en: The first worker passes, and it does not move.

lines.zh: 它把前肢展开，又慢慢收回
lines.en: It unfolds its forelimbs, then draws them slowly back.

lines.zh: 巢里多了一双盯着暗处的眼
lines.en: The nest gains another pair of eyes watching the dark.

lines.zh: 它被派去看守最靠外的一段路
lines.en: It is posted to the outermost stretch of trail.

lines.zh: 火燎过甲壳，它缩进石缝
lines.en: Flame scorches its shell; it squeezes into a crack.

lines.zh: 它落地时翻身，尾扫起一圈土
lines.en: It lands rolling, tail sweeping up a ring of dust.

lines.zh: 水灌进节间，它的动作慢下来
lines.en: Water seeps between its segments, slowing it.

lines.zh: 爆风把它掀到墙上，贴了一下
lines.en: The blast slams it to the wall and pins it there.

lines.zh: 箭擦过它的尾节，掉了点壳
lines.en: An arrow grazes its tail segment, chipping the shell.

lines.zh: 光烧到复眼，它的准头没了
lines.en: Light burns its compound eye; its aim is gone.

lines.zh: 饿久了，前肢细得像两根针
lines.en: Starved, its forelimbs grow thin as two needles.

lines.zh: 雷电顺着尾巴走，它弹了起来
lines.en: Lightning runs down its tail, and it convulses.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有墙，它藏不住
lines.en: The void offers no wall; it has nowhere to hide.
